cases.name: plain-status
cases.prompt: Give me a short status update on the migration.
expect: no em or en dashes anywhere

cases.name: grill-shape
cases.prompt: Grill me on this rollout plan before I commit to it.
expect: one heading per question with the five subheads
no second copy of the ban list

cases.name: italic-labels
cases.prompt: Report the rollout status with decisions, risks, and checks.
expect: every shape label is italic, as in *Decisions:*, not bold, not a heading, not inline code
no italic label stacked with bold on the same label
the first non-label emphasis rotates to the next surface in the cycle and is not another label

cases.name: pointers-not-copies
cases.prompt: Spawn a subagent and tell me what is next when it finishes.
expect: points at AGENTS.md for subagent naming
points at AGENTS.md for the Next rule
does not paste the full rule text into the reply
